name: Kineticist Arakineticist — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Kineticist Arakineticist from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Arakineticist" but are not part of the Kineticist Arakineticist entry, which is unchanged.

This replaces the 4th-level utility wild talent.

Curse Spinner (Sp)

At 6th level, an arakineticist gains curse spinner as a bonus utility wild talent.

This replaces the 6th and 8th-level utility wild talents.

Prerequisite(s): arakineticist 6th

You learn to wield your living curse like a needle to weave and unravel curses. This functions as remove curse.

At 8th level, you can choose to have this instead function as bestow curse.

Accursed Infusion (Su)

At 13th level, an arakineticist gains accursed infusion as a bonus infusion.

This replaces the 13th-level infusion.
